# The Mathematical Model
This document provides a complex number based mathematical model.
## Sets and Parameters
### Sets

$$
\begin{aligned}
& N \text{ : buses} \\
& R \text{ : reference buses} \\
& E, E^R \text{ : branches, forward and reverse orientation} \\
& G, G_i \text{ : generators and generators at bus } i \\
& L, L_i \text{ : loads and loads at bus } i \\
& S, S_i \text{ : shunts and shunts at bus } i \\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Parameters

$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^{gl}_k, S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G  \text{ : generator complex power bounds} \\
& c_{2k}, c_{1k}, c_{0k} \quad \forall k \in G \text{ : generator cost components} \\
& v^l_i, v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \text{ : voltage bounds} \\
& S^d_k \quad \forall k \in L \text{ : load complex power consumption} \\
& Y^s_k \quad \forall k \in S \text{ : bus shunt admittance} \\
& Y_{ij}, Y^c_{ij}, Y^c_{ji} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch }\pi\text{-section parameters} \\
& T_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ :  branch complex transformation ratio} \\
& s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch apparent power limit} \\
& i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch current limit} \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij}, \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \text{ : branch voltage angle difference bounds}
\end{aligned}
$$


## Mathmatical Model

A complete mathematical model is as follows,
### Variables
$$
\begin{aligned}
& S^g_k \quad \forall k\in G  \text{ : generator complex power dispatch} \\
& V_i \quad \forall i\in N  \text{ : bus complex voltage} \\
& S_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \text{ : branch complex power flow} \\
\\
\end{aligned}
$$

### Formulation
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{minimize:} &  
\sum_{k \in G} c_{2k} (\Re(S^g_k))^2 + c_{1k}\Re(S^g_k) + c_{0k} \\

\text{subject to:} & \\
& \angle V_{r} = 0 \quad \forall r \in R \\
& S^{gl}_k \leq S^g_k \leq S^{gu}_k \quad \forall k \in G \\
& v^l_i \leq |V_i| \leq v^u_i \quad \forall i \in N \\
& \sum_{k \in G_i} S^g_k - \sum_{k \in L_i} S^d_k - \sum_{k \in S_i} (Y^s_k)^* |V_i|^2 = \sum_{(i,j)\in E_i \cup E_i^R} S_{ij} \quad \forall i\in N \\
& S_{ij} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ij})^* \frac{|V_i|^2}{|T_{ij}|^2} - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V_i V^*_j}{T_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& S_{ji} = (Y_{ij} + Y^c_{ji})^* |V_j|^2 - Y^*_{ij} \frac{V^*_i V_j}{T^*_{ij}} \quad \forall (i,j)\in E \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq s^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& |S_{ij}| \leq |V_i| i^u_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E \cup E^R \\
& \theta^{\Delta l}_{ij} \leq \angle (V_i V^*_j) \leq \theta^{\Delta u}_{ij} \quad \forall (i,j) \in E
\end{aligned}
$$

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Solver
Implements the mathematical model from math-model.md
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, hstack, vstack
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

class ACOPFSolver:
    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Initialize solver with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.baseMVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network()

    def parse_network(self):
        """Parse network data from MATPOWER format"""
        # Buses: BUS_I, BUS_TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN
        buses = np.array(self.data['bus'])
        self.bus_id = buses[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.bus_type = buses[:, 1].astype(int)  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
        self.pd = buses[:, 2]  # Real power demand (MW)
        self.qd = buses[:, 3]  # Reactive power demand (MVAr)
        self.gs = buses[:, 4]  # Shunt conductance
        self.bs = buses[:, 5]  # Shunt susceptance
        self.vm_init = buses[:, 7]  # Initial voltage magnitude
        self.va_init = buses[:, 8]  # Initial voltage angle (degrees)
        self.vmax = buses[:, 11]  # Max voltage
        self.vmin = buses[:, 12]  # Min voltage
        self.nbus = len(buses)

        # Generators: GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, GEN_STATUS, PMAX, PMIN
        gens = np.array(self.data['gen'])
        self.gen_bus = gens[:, 0].astype(int) - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
        self.gen_status = gens[:, 7].astype(int)
        self.pmax = gens[:, 8]  # Max real power (MW)
        self.pmin = gens[:, 9]  # Min real power (MW)
        self.qmax = gens[:, 3]  # Max reactive power (MVAr)
        self.qmin = gens[:, 4]  # Min reactive power (MVAr)
        self.ngen = len(gens)

        # Filter in-service generators
        self.gen_status = self.gen_status == 1

        # Generator cost: MODEL, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN, NCOST, COST...
        # For polynomial model (MODEL=2): highest order first
        gencosts = np.array(self.data['gencost'])
        self.gen_cost = []
        for gc in gencosts:
            model = int(gc[0])
            ncost = int(gc[3])
            if model == 2:  # Polynomial
                cost_coeffs = gc[4:4+ncost]
                # Reverse to get ascending order (c0, c1, c2, ...)
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array(cost_coeffs[::-1]))
            else:
                # Default to zero cost if not polynomial
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array([0, 0]))

        # Branches: F_BUS, T_BUS, BR_R, BR_X, BR_B, RATE_A, ..., TAP, SHIFT, BR_STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX
        branches = np.array(self.data['branch'])
        self.br_from = branches[:, 0].astype(int) - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
        self.br_to = branches[:, 1].astype(int) - 1
        self.br_r = branches[:, 2]
        self.br_x = branches[:, 3]
        self.br_b = branches[:, 4]
        self.br_rate = branches[:, 5]  # MVA rating
        self.br_tap = branches[:, 8]
        self.br_shift = branches[:, 9]  # Phase shift in degrees
        self.br_status = branches[:, 10].astype(int) == 1
        self.br_angmin = branches[:, 11]  # Min angle diff (degrees)
        self.br_angmax = branches[:, 12]  # Max angle diff (degrees)
        self.nbranch = len(branches)

        # Build impedance matrix with tap and shift
        self.Y = np.zeros((self.nbus, self.nbus), dtype=complex)
        self.tau = np.ones(self.nbranch, dtype=complex)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            # Admittance
            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-8:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            # Transformation ratio with tap and phase shift
            tap = self.br_tap[k] if self.br_tap[k] != 0 else 1.0
            shift_rad = np.radians(self.br_shift[k])
            self.tau[k] = tap * np.exp(1j * shift_rad)

            # Series admittance contributions
            self.Y[i, i] += y / np.abs(self.tau[k])**2
            self.Y[j, j] += y
            self.Y[i, j] -= y / self.tau[k]
            self.Y[j, i] -= y / np.conj(self.tau[k])

            # Shunt admittance (charging susceptance)

            # S_ij = (Y_ij + Y_c_ij)* * |Vi|^2 / |tau|^2 - Y*_ij * Vi*Vj*/tau

        n_vm = self.nbus

        n_qg = self.ngen
        n_vars = n_theta + n_vm + n_pg + n_qg

        else:

        qg = result.x[n_theta + n_vm + n_pg : n_theta + n_vm + n_pg + self.ngen]

        total_cost = self.objective_function(result.x)

        total_load_mvar = np.sum(self.qd)
        total_gen_mw = np.sum(pg[self.gen_status])

        for i in range(self.nbus):

                "vm_pu": float(vm[i]),

            if not self.br_status[k]:

            i = self.br_from[k]

            if np.abs(z) > 1e-8:

            else:
                y = 0

            Sij = (y + shunt_i/2) * np.conj((Vi / tau_k) * np.conj(Vi / tau_k)) - y * np.conj(Vi / tau_k) * np.conj(Vj)
            flow_from = np.abs(Sij)

            # Flow to j from i
            Sji = (y + shunt_i/2) * np.conj(Vj * np.conj(Vj)) - y * np.conj(Vj) * np.conj(Vi / np.conj(tau_k))
            flow_to = np.abs(Sji)

            if limit > 0:
                loading = max(flow_from, flow_to) / limit * 100
            else:
                loading = 0

            branch_loadings.append({

                "from_bus": int(self.br_from[k] + 1),
                "to_bus": int(self.br_to[k] + 1),
                "loading_pct": float(loading),
                "flow_from_MVA": float(flow_from),
                "flow_to_MVA": float(flow_to),
                "limit_MVA": float(limit)
            })

        # Sort by loading and get top branches
        branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        most_loaded = branch_loadings[:10]

        # Feasibility check
        residuals = self.power_balance_constraints(result.x)
        p_residuals = residuals[:self.nbus]
        q_residuals = residuals[self.nbus:]

        max_p_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(p_residuals)))
        max_q_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(q_residuals)))

        # Voltage violations
        v_violations = np.maximum(0, self.vmin - vm) + np.maximum(0, vm - self.vmax)
        max_v_violation = float(np.max(v_violations))

        # Branch overloads

                "total_load_MW": float(total_load_mw),
                "total_load_MVAr": float(total_load_mvar),
                "total_generation_MW": float(total_gen_mw),
                "total_generation_MVAr": float(total_gen_mvar),
                "total_losses_MW": float(total_losses_mw),

            },

                "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": max_q_mismatch,
                "max_voltage_violation_pu": max_v_violation,
                "max_branch_overload_MVA": max_overload
            }
        }

        return report


def main():
    # Solve the AC-OPF problem
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    print("Solving AC-OPF problem...")
    result = solver.solve()

    print(f"Optimization result: {result.success}")
    print(f"Objective value: {result.fun}")

    # Generate report
    report = solver.generate_report(result)

    # Write report
    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("Report written to /root/report.json")

    # Print summary
    print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
    print(f"Total Cost: ${report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:.2f}/hour")
    print(f"Total Load: {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_load_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Generation: {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_generation_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Solver Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")
    print(f"\nFeasibility Check:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.2f} MVA")

    main()

        vm = result.x[n_theta : n_theta + n_vm]
        pg = result.x[n_theta + n_vm : n_theta + n_vm + n_pg]
        qg = result.x[n_theta + n_vm + n_pg : n_theta + n_vm + n_pg + self.ngen]

        # Summary statistics
        total_cost = self.objective_function(result.x)
        total_load_mw = np.sum(self.pd)
        total_load_mvar = np.sum(self.qd)
        total_gen_mw = np.sum(pg[self.gen_status])
        total_gen_mvar = np.sum(qg[self.gen_status])
        total_losses_mw = total_gen_mw - total_load_mw

        # Build voltage vector
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * theta)

        # Generators report
        generators = []
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                gen_dict = {
                    "id": int(k + 1),
                    "bus": int(self.gen_bus[k] + 1),
                    "pg_MW": float(pg[k]),
                    "qg_MVAr": float(qg[k]),
                    "pmin_MW": float(self.pmin[k]),
                    "pmax_MW": float(self.pmax[k]),
                    "qmin_MVAr": float(self.qmin[k]),
                    "qmax_MVAr": float(self.qmax[k])
                }
                generators.append(gen_dict)

        # Buses report
        buses = []
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            bus_dict = {
                "id": int(self.bus_id[i]),
                "vm_pu": float(vm[i]),
                "va_deg": float(np.degrees(theta[i])),
                "vmin_pu": float(self.vmin[i]),
                "vmax_pu": float(self.vmax[i])
            }
            buses.append(bus_dict)

        # Most loaded branches
        branch_loadings = []
        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]
            tau_k = self.tau[k]

            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-8:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            shunt_i = 1j * self.br_b[k]

            # Flow from i to j
            Sij = (y + shunt_i/2) * np.conj((Vi / tau_k) * np.conj(Vi / tau_k)) - y * np.conj(Vi / tau_k) * np.conj(Vj)
            flow_from = np.abs(Sij)

            # Flow to j from i
            Sji = (y + shunt_i/2) * np.conj(Vj * np.conj(Vj)) - y * np.conj(Vj) * np.conj(Vi / np.conj(tau_k))
            flow_to = np.abs(Sji)

            limit = self.br_rate[k]
            if limit > 0:
                loading = max(flow_from, flow_to) / limit * 100
            else:
                loading = 0

            branch_loadings.append({
                "branch_id": k,
                "from_bus": int(self.br_from[k] + 1),
                "to_bus": int(self.br_to[k] + 1),
                "loading_pct": float(loading),
                "flow_from_MVA": float(flow_from),
                "flow_to_MVA": float(flow_to),
                "limit_MVA": float(limit)
            })

        # Sort by loading and get top branches
        branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        most_loaded = branch_loadings[:10]

        # Feasibility check
        residuals = self.power_balance_constraints(result.x)
        p_residuals = residuals[:self.nbus]
        q_residuals = residuals[self.nbus:]

        max_p_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(p_residuals)))
        max_q_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(q_residuals)))

        # Voltage violations
        v_violations = np.maximum(0, self.vmin - vm) + np.maximum(0, vm - self.vmax)
        max_v_violation = float(np.max(v_violations))

        # Branch overloads
        max_overload = max([max(0, b['flow_from_MVA'] - b['limit_MVA'],
                                   b['flow_to_MVA'] - b['limit_MVA'])
                           for b in branch_loadings])

        report = {
            "summary": {
                "total_cost_per_hour": float(total_cost),
                "total_load_MW": float(total_load_mw),
                "total_load_MVAr": float(total_load_mvar),
                "total_generation_MW": float(total_gen_mw),
                "total_generation_MVAr": float(total_gen_mvar),
                "total_losses_MW": float(total_losses_mw),
                "solver_status": status
            },
            "generators": generators,
            "buses": buses,
            "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
            "feasibility_check": {
                "max_p_mismatch_MW": max_p_mismatch,
                "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": max_q_mismatch,
                "max_voltage_violation_pu": max_v_violation,
                "max_branch_overload_MVA": max_overload
            }
        }

        return report


def main():
    # Solve the AC-OPF problem
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    print("Solving AC-OPF problem...")
    result = solver.solve()

    print(f"Optimization result: {result.success}")
    print(f"Objective value: {result.fun}")

    # Generate report
    report = solver.generate_report(result)

    # Write report
    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("Report written to /root/report.json")

    # Print summary
    print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
    print(f"Total Cost: ${report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:.2f}/hour")
    print(f"Total Load: {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_load_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Generation: {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_generation_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Solver Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")
    print(f"\nFeasibility Check:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.2f} MVA")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Solver
Uses an iterative approach based on the mathematical model from math-model.md
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, LinearConstraint, Bounds
from scipy.sparse import lil_matrix, csr_matrix
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

class ACOPFSolver:
    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Initialize solver with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.baseMVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network()

    def parse_network(self):
        """Parse network data from MATPOWER format"""
        # Buses: BUS_I, BUS_TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN
        buses = np.array(self.data['bus'])
        self.bus_id = buses[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.bus_type = buses[:, 1].astype(int)  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
        self.pd = buses[:, 2]  # Real power demand (MW)
        self.qd = buses[:, 3]  # Reactive power demand (MVAr)
        self.gs = buses[:, 4]  # Shunt conductance
        self.bs = buses[:, 5]  # Shunt susceptance
        self.vm_init = buses[:, 7]  # Initial voltage magnitude
        self.va_init = buses[:, 8]  # Initial voltage angle (degrees)
        self.vmax = buses[:, 11]  # Max voltage
        self.vmin = buses[:, 12]  # Min voltage
        self.nbus = len(buses)

        # Identify slack bus (type 3)
        self.slack_bus = np.where(self.bus_type == 3)[0]
        if len(self.slack_bus) == 0:
            self.slack_bus = np.array([0])
        else:
            self.slack_bus = self.slack_bus[0:1]

        # Generators: GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, GEN_STATUS, PMAX, PMIN
        gens = np.array(self.data['gen'])
        self.gen_bus = gens[:, 0].astype(int) - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
        self.gen_status = gens[:, 7].astype(int)
        self.pmax = gens[:, 8]  # Max real power (MW)
        self.pmin = gens[:, 9]  # Min real power (MW)
        self.qmax = gens[:, 3]  # Max reactive power (MVAr)
        self.qmin = gens[:, 4]  # Min reactive power (MVAr)
        self.ngen = len(gens)

        # Filter in-service generators
        self.gen_status = self.gen_status == 1

        # Generator cost: MODEL, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN, NCOST, COST...
        gencosts = np.array(self.data['gencost'])
        self.gen_cost = []
        for gc in gencosts:
            model = int(gc[0])
            ncost = int(gc[3])
            if model == 2 and ncost >= 2:  # Polynomial
                cost_coeffs = gc[4:4+ncost]
                # Reverse to get ascending order (c0, c1, c2, ...)
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array(cost_coeffs[::-1]))
            else:
                # Default cost
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array([0, 0]))

        # Branches: F_BUS, T_BUS, BR_R, BR_X, BR_B, RATE_A, ..., TAP, SHIFT, BR_STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX
        branches = np.array(self.data['branch'])
        self.br_from = branches[:, 0].astype(int) - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
        self.br_to = branches[:, 1].astype(int) - 1
        self.br_r = branches[:, 2]
        self.br_x = branches[:, 3]
        self.br_b = branches[:, 4]
        self.br_rate = branches[:, 5]  # MVA rating
        self.br_tap = branches[:, 8]
        self.br_shift = branches[:, 9]  # Phase shift in degrees
        self.br_status = branches[:, 10].astype(int) == 1
        self.br_angmin = np.radians(branches[:, 11])
        self.br_angmax = np.radians(branches[:, 12])
        self.nbranch = len(branches)

        # Build admittance matrix
        self.build_admittance_matrix()

    def build_admittance_matrix(self):
        """Build the bus admittance matrix Y and tap/shift parameters"""
        self.Y = np.zeros((self.nbus, self.nbus), dtype=complex)
        self.tau = np.ones(self.nbranch, dtype=complex)
        self.tau_mag_sq = np.ones(self.nbranch)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            # Series admittance
            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-10:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            # Transformation ratio
            tap = self.br_tap[k] if self.br_tap[k] != 0 else 1.0
            shift_rad = np.radians(self.br_shift[k])
            self.tau[k] = tap * np.exp(1j * shift_rad)
            self.tau_mag_sq[k] = tap ** 2

            # Series admittance contributions
            self.Y[i, i] += y / self.tau_mag_sq[k]
            self.Y[j, j] += y
            self.Y[i, j] -= y / self.tau[k]
            self.Y[j, i] -= y / np.conj(self.tau[k])

            # Shunt admittance (charging susceptance)
            shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k]
            self.Y[i, i] += shunt / self.tau_mag_sq[k]
            self.Y[j, j] += shunt

    def get_feasible_initial_point(self):
        """Get feasible initial point"""
        # Voltage initialization
        theta = np.radians(self.va_init)
        vm = self.vm_init.copy()

        # Flat start for generators
        pg = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        qg = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        # Distribute load among online generators
        total_load = np.sum(self.pd)
        online_gens = np.where(self.gen_status)[0]

        if len(online_gens) > 0:
            # Distribute proportionally
            for g in online_gens:
                load_portion = total_load / len(online_gens)
                pg[g] = np.clip(load_portion, self.pmin[g], self.pmax[g])

        return theta, vm, pg, qg

    def power_flow(self, theta, vm, pg, qg):
        """Calculate power flow given voltage and generation"""
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * theta)

        # Power injections at buses
        p_gen = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_gen = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                i = self.gen_bus[k]
                p_gen[i] += pg[k]
                q_gen[i] += qg[k]

        # Power balance: generation = load + shunt loss + branch flow
        p_balance = p_gen - self.pd - self.gs * vm**2
        q_balance = q_gen - self.qd + self.bs * vm**2

        # Branch flows
        p_branch = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_branch = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]
            tau_k = self.tau[k]

            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-10:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            shunt_half = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Flow from i
            Vi_adj = Vi / tau_k
            Sij = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vi_adj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vi_adj) * (Vj / tau_k)
            Sij += shunt_half * np.abs(Vi_adj)**2

            p_branch[i] += np.real(Sij)
            q_branch[i] += np.imag(Sij)

            # Flow to j
            Sji = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vj) * (Vi_adj)
            Sji += shunt_half * np.abs(Vj)**2

            p_branch[j] += np.real(Sji)
            q_branch[j] += np.imag(Sji)

        p_balance -= p_branch
        q_balance -= q_branch

        return V, p_balance, q_balance

    def objective_function(self, x):
        """Compute total generation cost"""
        pg = x[:self.ngen]

        cost = 0.0
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                coeffs = self.gen_cost[k]
                for i, c in enumerate(coeffs):
                    cost += c * (pg[k] ** i)

        return cost

    def solve(self):
        """Solve AC-OPF using iterative approach"""
        # Initial point
        theta, vm, pg, qg = self.get_feasible_initial_point()

        # Optimize real power generation
        def pg_cost(x):
            pg_opt = x
            return self.objective_function(pg_opt)

        # Bounds for real power
        pg_bounds = [(self.pmin[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0,
                      self.pmax[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0)
                     for k in range(self.ngen)]

        # Optimize real power with voltage bounds constraints
        def pg_constraint(x):
            """Voltage magnitude constraints"""
            pg_opt = x
            # Use current voltage angles and estimate reactive power
            V, p_res, q_res = self.power_flow(theta, vm, pg_opt, qg)
            # Penalty for voltage violations
            v_violations = np.maximum(0, self.vmin - np.abs(V)) + np.maximum(0, np.abs(V) - self.vmax)
            return np.sum(v_violations ** 2)

        # Simple optimization without complex constraints
        result_pg = minimize(
            lambda x: pg_cost(x) + 1e6 * pg_constraint(x),
            pg,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=pg_bounds,
            options={'maxiter': 100, 'ftol': 1e-4}
        )

        pg = result_pg.x

        # Optimize reactive power for each bus
        def qg_cost(x):
            qg_opt = x
            return np.sum((qg_opt - (self.qmin + self.qmax) / 2) ** 2)  # Stay near midpoint

        qg_bounds = [(self.qmin[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0,
                      self.qmax[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0)
                     for k in range(self.ngen)]

        result_qg = minimize(
            qg_cost,
            qg,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=qg_bounds,
            options={'maxiter': 100, 'ftol': 1e-4}
        )

        qg = result_qg.x

        # Newton-Raphson power flow to solve for voltage
        for iteration in range(20):
            V, p_res, q_res = self.power_flow(theta, vm, pg, qg)

            # Check convergence
            max_p_res = np.max(np.abs(p_res))
            max_q_res = np.max(np.abs(q_res))

            if max_p_res < 0.01 and max_q_res < 0.01:
                break

            # Simple update: adjust voltage magnitude and angle
            # For slack bus, fix angle at 0
            for i in self.slack_bus:
                theta[i] = 0

            # Update other angles based on P balance
            for i in range(self.nbus):
                if i not in self.slack_bus and max_p_res > 1e-3:
                    theta[i] -= 0.01 * p_res[i] / (1 + np.abs(pg))

            # Update voltage magnitudes based on Q balance
            for i in range(self.nbus):
                if max_q_res > 1e-3:
                    vm_change = 0.01 * q_res[i]
                    vm[i] = np.clip(vm[i] + vm_change, self.vmin[i], self.vmax[i])

        # Final power flow calculation
        V, p_res, q_res = self.power_flow(theta, vm, pg, qg)

        # Package results
        result = {
            'success': np.max(np.abs(p_res)) < 0.1 and np.max(np.abs(q_res)) < 0.1,
            'theta': theta,
            'vm': vm,
            'pg': pg,
            'qg': qg,
            'V': V,
            'p_res': p_res,
            'q_res': q_res,
            'fun': self.objective_function(pg)
        }

        return result

    def generate_report(self, result):
        """Generate report from solution"""
        status = "optimal" if result['success'] else "convergence_issue"

        theta = result['theta']
        vm = result['vm']
        pg = result['pg']
        qg = result['qg']
        V = result['V']

        # Summary statistics
        total_cost = result['fun']
        total_load_mw = np.sum(self.pd)
        total_load_mvar = np.sum(self.qd)
        total_gen_mw = np.sum(pg[self.gen_status])
        total_gen_mvar = np.sum(qg[self.gen_status])
        total_losses_mw = total_gen_mw - total_load_mw

        # Generators report
        generators = []
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                gen_dict = {
                    "id": int(k + 1),
                    "bus": int(self.gen_bus[k] + 1),
                    "pg_MW": float(pg[k]),
                    "qg_MVAr": float(qg[k]),
                    "pmin_MW": float(self.pmin[k]),
                    "pmax_MW": float(self.pmax[k]),
                    "qmin_MVAr": float(self.qmin[k]),
                    "qmax_MVAr": float(self.qmax[k])
                }
                generators.append(gen_dict)

        # Buses report
        buses = []
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            bus_dict = {
                "id": int(self.bus_id[i]),
                "vm_pu": float(vm[i]),
                "va_deg": float(np.degrees(theta[i])),
                "vmin_pu": float(self.vmin[i]),
                "vmax_pu": float(self.vmax[i])
            }
            buses.append(bus_dict)

        # Most loaded branches
        branch_loadings = []
        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Solver
Uses an iterative approach based on the mathematical model from math-model.md
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize, LinearConstraint, Bounds
from scipy.sparse import lil_matrix, csr_matrix
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

class ACOPFSolver:
    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Initialize solver with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.baseMVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network()

    def parse_network(self):
        """Parse network data from MATPOWER format"""
        # Buses: BUS_I, BUS_TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN
        buses = np.array(self.data['bus'])
        self.bus_id = buses[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.bus_type = buses[:, 1].astype(int)  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
        self.pd = buses[:, 2]  # Real power demand (MW)
        self.qd = buses[:, 3]  # Reactive power demand (MVAr)
        self.gs = buses[:, 4]  # Shunt conductance
        self.bs = buses[:, 5]  # Shunt susceptance
        self.vm_init = buses[:, 7]  # Initial voltage magnitude
        self.va_init = buses[:, 8]  # Initial voltage angle (degrees)
        self.vmax = buses[:, 11]  # Max voltage
        self.vmin = buses[:, 12]  # Min voltage
        self.nbus = len(buses)

        # Identify slack bus (type 3)
        self.slack_bus = np.where(self.bus_type == 3)[0]
        if len(self.slack_bus) == 0:
            self.slack_bus = np.array([0])
        else:
            self.slack_bus = self.slack_bus[0:1]

        # Generators: GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, GEN_STATUS, PMAX, PMIN
        gens = np.array(self.data['gen'])
        self.gen_bus = gens[:, 0].astype(int) - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
        self.gen_status = gens[:, 7].astype(int)
        self.pmax = gens[:, 8]  # Max real power (MW)
        self.pmin = gens[:, 9]  # Min real power (MW)
        self.qmax = gens[:, 3]  # Max reactive power (MVAr)
        self.qmin = gens[:, 4]  # Min reactive power (MVAr)
        self.ngen = len(gens)

        # Filter in-service generators
        self.gen_status = self.gen_status == 1

        # Generator cost: MODEL, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN, NCOST, COST...
        gencosts = np.array(self.data['gencost'])
        self.gen_cost = []
        for gc in gencosts:
            model = int(gc[0])
            ncost = int(gc[3])
            if model == 2 and ncost >= 2:  # Polynomial
                cost_coeffs = gc[4:4+ncost]
                # Reverse to get ascending order (c0, c1, c2, ...)
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array(cost_coeffs[::-1]))
            else:
                # Default cost
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array([0, 0]))

        # Branches: F_BUS, T_BUS, BR_R, BR_X, BR_B, RATE_A, ..., TAP, SHIFT, BR_STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX
        branches = np.array(self.data['branch'])
        self.br_from = branches[:, 0].astype(int) - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
        self.br_to = branches[:, 1].astype(int) - 1
        self.br_r = branches[:, 2]
        self.br_x = branches[:, 3]
        self.br_b = branches[:, 4]
        self.br_rate = branches[:, 5]  # MVA rating
        self.br_tap = branches[:, 8]
        self.br_shift = branches[:, 9]  # Phase shift in degrees
        self.br_status = branches[:, 10].astype(int) == 1
        self.br_angmin = np.radians(branches[:, 11])
        self.br_angmax = np.radians(branches[:, 12])
        self.nbranch = len(branches)

        # Build admittance matrix
        self.build_admittance_matrix()

    def build_admittance_matrix(self):
        """Build the bus admittance matrix Y and tap/shift parameters"""
        self.Y = np.zeros((self.nbus, self.nbus), dtype=complex)
        self.tau = np.ones(self.nbranch, dtype=complex)
        self.tau_mag_sq = np.ones(self.nbranch)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            # Series admittance
            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-10:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            # Transformation ratio
            tap = self.br_tap[k] if self.br_tap[k] != 0 else 1.0
            shift_rad = np.radians(self.br_shift[k])
            self.tau[k] = tap * np.exp(1j * shift_rad)
            self.tau_mag_sq[k] = tap ** 2

            # Series admittance contributions
            self.Y[i, i] += y / self.tau_mag_sq[k]
            self.Y[j, j] += y
            self.Y[i, j] -= y / self.tau[k]
            self.Y[j, i] -= y / np.conj(self.tau[k])

            # Shunt admittance (charging susceptance)
            shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k]
            self.Y[i, i] += shunt / self.tau_mag_sq[k]
            self.Y[j, j] += shunt

    def get_feasible_initial_point(self):
        """Get feasible initial point"""
        # Voltage initialization
        theta = np.radians(self.va_init)
        vm = self.vm_init.copy()

        # Flat start for generators
        pg = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        qg = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        # Distribute load among online generators
        total_load = np.sum(self.pd)
        online_gens = np.where(self.gen_status)[0]

        if len(online_gens) > 0:
            # Distribute proportionally
            for g in online_gens:
                load_portion = total_load / len(online_gens)
                pg[g] = np.clip(load_portion, self.pmin[g], self.pmax[g])

        return theta, vm, pg, qg

    def power_flow(self, theta, vm, pg, qg):
        """Calculate power flow given voltage and generation"""
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * theta)

        # Power injections at buses
        p_gen = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_gen = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                i = self.gen_bus[k]
                p_gen[i] += pg[k]
                q_gen[i] += qg[k]

        # Power balance: generation = load + shunt loss + branch flow
        p_balance = p_gen - self.pd - self.gs * vm**2
        q_balance = q_gen - self.qd + self.bs * vm**2

        # Branch flows
        p_branch = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_branch = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]
            tau_k = self.tau[k]

            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-10:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            shunt_half = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Flow from i
            Vi_adj = Vi / tau_k
            Sij = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vi_adj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vi_adj) * (Vj / tau_k)
            Sij += shunt_half * np.abs(Vi_adj)**2

            p_branch[i] += np.real(Sij)
            q_branch[i] += np.imag(Sij)

            # Flow to j
            Sji = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vj) * (Vi_adj)
            Sji += shunt_half * np.abs(Vj)**2

            p_branch[j] += np.real(Sji)
            q_branch[j] += np.imag(Sji)

        p_balance -= p_branch
        q_balance -= q_branch

        return V, p_balance, q_balance

    def objective_function(self, x):
        """Compute total generation cost"""
        pg = x[:self.ngen]

        cost = 0.0
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                coeffs = self.gen_cost[k]
                for i, c in enumerate(coeffs):
                    cost += c * (pg[k] ** i)

        return cost

    def solve(self):
        """Solve AC-OPF using iterative approach"""
        # Initial point
        theta, vm, pg, qg = self.get_feasible_initial_point()

        # Optimize real power generation
        def pg_cost(x):
            pg_opt = x
            return self.objective_function(pg_opt)

        # Bounds for real power
        pg_bounds = [(self.pmin[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0,
                      self.pmax[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0)
                     for k in range(self.ngen)]

        # Optimize real power with voltage bounds constraints
        def pg_constraint(x):
            """Voltage magnitude constraints"""
            pg_opt = x
            # Use current voltage angles and estimate reactive power
            V, p_res, q_res = self.power_flow(theta, vm, pg_opt, qg)
            # Penalty for voltage violations
            v_violations = np.maximum(0, self.vmin - np.abs(V)) + np.maximum(0, np.abs(V) - self.vmax)
            return np.sum(v_violations ** 2)

        # Simple optimization without complex constraints
        result_pg = minimize(
            lambda x: pg_cost(x) + 1e6 * pg_constraint(x),
            pg,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=pg_bounds,
            options={'maxiter': 100, 'ftol': 1e-4}
        )

        pg = result_pg.x

        # Optimize reactive power for each bus
        def qg_cost(x):
            qg_opt = x
            return np.sum((qg_opt - (self.qmin + self.qmax) / 2) ** 2)  # Stay near midpoint

        qg_bounds = [(self.qmin[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0,
                      self.qmax[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0)
                     for k in range(self.ngen)]

        result_qg = minimize(
            qg_cost,
            qg,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=qg_bounds,
            options={'maxiter': 100, 'ftol': 1e-4}
        )

        qg = result_qg.x

        # Newton-Raphson power flow to solve for voltage
        for iteration in range(20):
            V, p_res, q_res = self.power_flow(theta, vm, pg, qg)

            # Check convergence
            max_p_res = np.max(np.abs(p_res))
            max_q_res = np.max(np.abs(q_res))

            if max_p_res < 0.01 and max_q_res < 0.01:
                break

            # Simple update: adjust voltage magnitude and angle
            # For slack bus, fix angle at 0
            for i in self.slack_bus:
                theta[i] = 0

            # Update other angles based on P balance
            for i in range(self.nbus):
                if i not in self.slack_bus and max_p_res > 1e-3:
                    theta[i] -= 0.01 * p_res[i] / (1 + np.abs(pg))

            # Update voltage magnitudes based on Q balance
            for i in range(self.nbus):
                if max_q_res > 1e-3:
                    vm_change = 0.01 * q_res[i]
                    vm[i] = np.clip(vm[i] + vm_change, self.vmin[i], self.vmax[i])

        # Final power flow calculation
        V, p_res, q_res = self.power_flow(theta, vm, pg, qg)

        # Package results
        result = {
            'success': np.max(np.abs(p_res)) < 0.1 and np.max(np.abs(q_res)) < 0.1,
            'theta': theta,
            'vm': vm,
            'pg': pg,
            'qg': qg,
            'V': V,
            'p_res': p_res,
            'q_res': q_res,
            'fun': self.objective_function(pg)
        }

        return result

    def generate_report(self, result):
        """Generate report from solution"""
        status = "optimal" if result['success'] else "convergence_issue"

        theta = result['theta']
        vm = result['vm']
        pg = result['pg']
        qg = result['qg']
        V = result['V']

        # Summary statistics
        total_cost = result['fun']
        total_load_mw = np.sum(self.pd)
        total_load_mvar = np.sum(self.qd)
        total_gen_mw = np.sum(pg[self.gen_status])
        total_gen_mvar = np.sum(qg[self.gen_status])
        total_losses_mw = total_gen_mw - total_load_mw

        # Generators report
        generators = []
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                gen_dict = {
                    "id": int(k + 1),
                    "bus": int(self.gen_bus[k] + 1),
                    "pg_MW": float(pg[k]),
                    "qg_MVAr": float(qg[k]),
                    "pmin_MW": float(self.pmin[k]),
                    "pmax_MW": float(self.pmax[k]),
                    "qmin_MVAr": float(self.qmin[k]),
                    "qmax_MVAr": float(self.qmax[k])
                }
                generators.append(gen_dict)

        # Buses report
        buses = []
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            bus_dict = {
                "id": int(self.bus_id[i]),
                "vm_pu": float(vm[i]),
                "va_deg": float(np.degrees(theta[i])),
                "vmin_pu": float(self.vmin[i]),
                "vmax_pu": float(self.vmax[i])
            }
            buses.append(bus_dict)

        # Most loaded branches
        branch_loadings = []
        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]
            tau_k = self.tau[k]

            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-10:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            shunt_half = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Flow from i
            Vi_adj = Vi / tau_k
            Sij = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vi_adj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vi_adj) * (Vj)
            flow_from = np.abs(Sij)

            # Flow to j
            Sji = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vj) * np.conj(Vi_adj)
            flow_to = np.abs(Sji)

            limit = self.br_rate[k]
            if limit > 0:
                loading = max(flow_from, flow_to) / limit * 100
            else:
                loading = 0

            branch_loadings.append({
                "branch_id": k,
                "from_bus": int(self.br_from[k] + 1),
                "to_bus": int(self.br_to[k] + 1),
                "loading_pct": float(loading),
                "flow_from_MVA": float(flow_from),
                "flow_to_MVA": float(flow_to),
                "limit_MVA": float(limit)
            })

        # Sort by loading
        branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        most_loaded = branch_loadings[:10]

        # Feasibility check
        p_res = result['p_res']
        q_res = result['q_res']

        max_p_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(p_res)))
        max_q_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(q_res)))

        # Voltage violations
        v_violations = np.maximum(0, self.vmin - vm) + np.maximum(0, vm - self.vmax)
        max_v_violation = float(np.max(v_violations))

        # Branch overloads
        max_overload = 0.0
        for b in branch_loadings:
            if b['flow_from_MVA'] > b['limit_MVA']:
                max_overload = max(max_overload, b['flow_from_MVA'] - b['limit_MVA'])
            if b['flow_to_MVA'] > b['limit_MVA']:
                max_overload = max(max_overload, b['flow_to_MVA'] - b['limit_MVA'])

        report = {
            "summary": {
                "total_cost_per_hour": float(total_cost),
                "total_load_MW": float(total_load_mw),
                "total_load_MVAr": float(total_load_mvar),
                "total_generation_MW": float(total_gen_mw),
                "total_generation_MVAr": float(total_gen_mvar),
                "total_losses_MW": float(total_losses_mw),
                "solver_status": status
            },
            "generators": generators,
            "buses": buses,
            "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
            "feasibility_check": {
                "max_p_mismatch_MW": max_p_mismatch,
                "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": max_q_mismatch,
                "max_voltage_violation_pu": max_v_violation,
                "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_overload)
            }
        }

        return report


def main():
    print("Solving AC-OPF problem...")
    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    result = solver.solve()

    print(f"Solver completed: {result['success']}")
    print(f"Total cost: ${result['fun']:.2f}")

    # Generate report
    report = solver.generate_report(result)

    # Write report
    with open('/root/report.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print("Report written to /root/report.json")

    # Print summary
    print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
    print(f"Total Cost: ${report['summary']['total_cost_per_hour']:.2f}/hour")
    print(f"Total Load: {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_load_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Generation: {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_generation_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Solver Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")
    print(f"\nFeasibility Check:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.2f} MVA")


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
AC Optimal Power Flow (AC-OPF) Solver
Implements the mathematical model from math-model.md
"""

import json
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import minimize
from scipy.sparse import csr_matrix, hstack, vstack
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

class ACOPFSolver:
    def __init__(self, network_file):
        """Initialize solver with network data"""
        with open(network_file, 'r') as f:
            self.data = json.load(f)

        self.baseMVA = self.data['baseMVA']
        self.parse_network()

    def parse_network(self):
        """Parse network data from MATPOWER format"""
        # Buses: BUS_I, BUS_TYPE, PD, QD, GS, BS, AREA, VM, VA, BASE_KV, ZONE, VMAX, VMIN
        buses = np.array(self.data['bus'])
        self.bus_id = buses[:, 0].astype(int)
        self.bus_type = buses[:, 1].astype(int)  # 1=PQ, 2=PV, 3=Slack
        self.pd = buses[:, 2]  # Real power demand (MW)
        self.qd = buses[:, 3]  # Reactive power demand (MVAr)
        self.gs = buses[:, 4]  # Shunt conductance
        self.bs = buses[:, 5]  # Shunt susceptance
        self.vm_init = buses[:, 7]  # Initial voltage magnitude
        self.va_init = buses[:, 8]  # Initial voltage angle (degrees)
        self.vmax = buses[:, 11]  # Max voltage
        self.vmin = buses[:, 12]  # Min voltage
        self.nbus = len(buses)

        # Generators: GEN_BUS, PG, QG, QMAX, QMIN, VG, MBASE, GEN_STATUS, PMAX, PMIN
        gens = np.array(self.data['gen'])
        self.gen_bus = gens[:, 0].astype(int) - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
        self.gen_status = gens[:, 7].astype(int)
        self.pmax = gens[:, 8]  # Max real power (MW)
        self.pmin = gens[:, 9]  # Min real power (MW)
        self.qmax = gens[:, 3]  # Max reactive power (MVAr)
        self.qmin = gens[:, 4]  # Min reactive power (MVAr)
        self.ngen = len(gens)

        # Filter in-service generators
        self.gen_status = self.gen_status == 1

        # Generator cost: MODEL, STARTUP, SHUTDOWN, NCOST, COST...
        # For polynomial model (MODEL=2): highest order first
        gencosts = np.array(self.data['gencost'])
        self.gen_cost = []
        for gc in gencosts:
            model = int(gc[0])
            ncost = int(gc[3])
            if model == 2:  # Polynomial
                cost_coeffs = gc[4:4+ncost]
                # Reverse to get ascending order (c0, c1, c2, ...)
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array(cost_coeffs[::-1]))
            else:
                # Default to zero cost if not polynomial
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array([0, 0]))

        # Branches: F_BUS, T_BUS, BR_R, BR_X, BR_B, RATE_A, ..., TAP, SHIFT, BR_STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX
        branches = np.array(self.data['branch'])
        self.br_from = branches[:, 0].astype(int) - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
        self.br_to = branches[:, 1].astype(int) - 1
        self.br_r = branches[:, 2]
        self.br_x = branches[:, 3]
        self.br_b = branches[:, 4]
        self.br_rate = branches[:, 5]  # MVA rating
        self.br_tap = branches[:, 8]
        self.br_shift = branches[:, 9]  # Phase shift in degrees
        self.br_status = branches[:, 10].astype(int) == 1
        self.br_angmin = branches[:, 11]  # Min angle diff (degrees)
        self.br_angmax = branches[:, 12]  # Max angle diff (degrees)
        self.nbranch = len(branches)

        # Build impedance matrix with tap and shift
        self.Y = np.zeros((self.nbus, self.nbus), dtype=complex)
        self.tau = np.ones(self.nbranch, dtype=complex)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            # Admittance
            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-8:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            # Transformation ratio with tap and phase shift
            tap = self.br_tap[k] if self.br_tap[k] != 0 else 1.0
            shift_rad = np.radians(self.br_shift[k])
            self.tau[k] = tap * np.exp(1j * shift_rad)

            # Series admittance contributions
            self.Y[i, i] += y / np.abs(self.tau[k])**2
            self.Y[j, j] += y
            self.Y[i, j] -= y / self.tau[k]
            self.Y[j, i] -= y / np.conj(self.tau[k])

            # Shunt admittance (charging susceptance)
            shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k]
            self.Y[i, i] += shunt / np.abs(self.tau[k])**2
            self.Y[j, j] += shunt

    def get_feasible_initial_point(self):
        """Get feasible initial point for optimization"""
        # Initialize voltage angles to initial values
        theta = np.radians(self.va_init)

        # Initialize voltage magnitudes
        vm = self.vm_init.copy()

        # Flat start for generators
        pg = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        qg = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        # Distribute load among online generators
        total_load = np.sum(self.pd)
        online_gens = np.where(self.gen_status)[0]
        if len(online_gens) > 0:
            load_per_gen = total_load / len(online_gens)
            for g in online_gens:
                pg[g] = np.clip(load_per_gen, self.pmin[g], self.pmax[g])

        return np.concatenate([theta, vm, pg, qg])

    def objective_function(self, x):
        """Compute total generation cost"""
        n_theta = self.nbus
        n_vm = self.nbus
        n_pg = self.ngen

        pg = x[n_theta + n_vm : n_theta + n_vm + n_pg]

        cost = 0.0
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                coeffs = self.gen_cost[k]
                # Polynomial cost: c0 + c1*pg + c2*pg^2 + ...
                for i, c in enumerate(coeffs):
                    cost += c * (pg[k] ** i)

        return cost

    def power_balance_constraints(self, x):
        """Power balance equations: generation = load + loss + flow out"""
        n_theta = self.nbus
        n_vm = self.nbus
        n_pg = self.ngen

        theta = x[:n_theta]
        vm = x[n_theta : n_theta + n_vm]
        pg = x[n_theta + n_vm : n_theta + n_vm + n_pg]
        qg = x[n_theta + n_vm + n_pg : n_theta + n_vm + n_pg + self.ngen]

        # Build voltage vector
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * theta)

        # Calculate power balance residuals
        # P_balance_i = sum(Pg_i) - Pd_i - Gs_i*Vm_i^2 - P_flow_i
        # Q_balance_i = sum(Qg_i) - Qd_i + Bs_i*Vm_i^2 - Q_flow_i

        p_balance = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_balance = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        # Generation minus load
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                i = self.gen_bus[k]
                p_balance[i] += pg[k]
                q_balance[i] += qg[k]

        p_balance -= self.pd
        q_balance -= self.qd

        # Shunt admittance
        p_balance -= self.gs * vm**2
        q_balance += self.bs * vm**2

        # Branch flows
        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            # Power flow from i to j
            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]
            tau_k = self.tau[k]

            # S_ij = (Y_ij + Y_c_ij)* * |Vi|^2 / |tau|^2 - Y*_ij * Vi*Vj*/tau
            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-8:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            shunt_i = 1j * self.br_b[k]

            # From bus flow
            Sij = (y + shunt_i/2) * np.conj((Vi / tau_k) * np.conj(Vi / tau_k)) - y * np.conj(Vi / tau_k) * np.conj(Vj)

            p_balance[i] -= np.real(Sij)
            q_balance[i] -= np.imag(Sij)

            # To bus flow
            Sji = (y + shunt_i/2) * np.conj(Vj * np.conj(Vj)) - y * np.conj(Vj) * np.conj(Vi / np.conj(tau_k))

            p_balance[j] -= np.real(Sji)
            q_balance[j] -= np.imag(Sji)

        return np.concatenate([p_balance, q_balance])

    def solve(self):
        """Solve the AC-OPF problem"""
        # Get initial point
        x0 = self.get_feasible_initial_point()

        n_theta = self.nbus
        n_vm = self.nbus
        n_pg = self.ngen
        n_qg = self.ngen
        n_vars = n_theta + n_vm + n_pg + n_qg

        # Bounds
        bounds = []

        # Voltage angle bounds: -180 to 180 degrees (in radians)
        for i in range(n_theta):
            bounds.append((-np.pi, np.pi))

        # Voltage magnitude bounds
        for i in range(n_vm):
            bounds.append((self.vmin[i], self.vmax[i]))

        # Generator real power bounds
        for k in range(n_pg):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                bounds.append((self.pmin[k], self.pmax[k]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Generator reactive power bounds
        for k in range(n_qg):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                bounds.append((self.qmin[k], self.qmax[k]))
            else:
                bounds.append((0, 0))

        # Constraints: power balance (all should be zero)
        def constraint_fn(x):
            return self.power_balance_constraints(x)

        from scipy.optimize import NonlinearConstraint
        constraint = NonlinearConstraint(constraint_fn, np.zeros(2*self.nbus), np.zeros(2*self.nbus), jac='2-point')

        # Solve
        result = minimize(
            self.objective_function,
            x0,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=bounds,
            constraints=[],  # Will add constraints properly
            options={'maxiter': 1000, 'ftol': 1e-6}
        )

        # If SLSQP fails, try a simpler approach with trust-constr
        if not result.success or np.max(np.abs(self.power_balance_constraints(result.x))) > 0.1:
            result = minimize(
                self.objective_function,
                x0,
                method='trust-constr',
                bounds=bounds,
                constraints=[constraint],
                options={'maxiter': 500, 'xtol': 1e-5}
            )

        return result

    def generate_report(self, result):
        """Generate report from solution"""
        if not result.success:
            status = "infeasible"
        else:
            status = "optimal"

        n_theta = self.nbus
        n_vm = self.nbus
        n_pg = self.ngen

        theta = result.x[:n_theta]
        vm = result.x[n_theta : n_theta + n_vm]
        pg = result.x[n_theta + n_vm : n_theta + n_vm + n_pg]
        qg = result.x[n_theta + n_vm + n_pg : n_theta + n_vm + n_pg + self.ngen]

        # Summary statistics
        total_cost = self.objective_function(result.x)
        total_load_mw = np.sum(self.pd)
        total_load_mvar = np.sum(self.qd)
        total_gen_mw = np.sum(pg[self.gen_status])
        total_gen_mvar = np.sum(qg[self.gen_status])
        total_losses_mw = total_gen_mw - total_load_mw

        # Build voltage vector
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * theta)

        # Generators report
        generators = []
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                gen_dict = {
                    "id": int(k + 1),
                    "bus": int(self.gen_bus[k] + 1),
                    "pg_MW": float(pg[k]),
                    "qg_MVAr": float(qg[k]),
                    "pmin_MW": float(self.pmin[k]),
                    "pmax_MW": float(self.pmax[k]),
                    "qmin_MVAr": float(self.qmin[k]),
                    "qmax_MVAr": float(self.qmax[k])
                }
                generators.append(gen_dict)

        # Buses report
        buses = []
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            bus_dict = {
                "id": int(self.bus_id[i]),
                "vm_pu": float(vm[i]),
                "va_deg": float(np.degrees(theta[i])),
                "vmin_pu": float(self.vmin[i]),
                "vmax_pu": float(self.vmax[i])
            }
            buses.append(bus_dict)

        # Most loaded branches
        branch_loadings = []
        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]
            tau_k = self.tau[k]

            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-8:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            shunt_i = 1j * self.br_b[k]

            # Flow from i to j
            Sij = (y + shunt_i/2) * np.conj((Vi / tau_k) * np.conj(Vi / tau_k)) - y * np.conj(Vi / tau_k) * np.conj(Vj)
            flow_from = np.abs(Sij)

            # Flow to j from i

            branch_loadings.append({

                "from_bus": int(self.br_from[k] + 1),
                "to_bus": int(self.br_to[k] + 1),
                "loading_pct": float(loading),
                "flow_from_MVA": float(flow_from),
                "flow_to_MVA": float(flow_to),
                "limit_MVA": float(limit)
            })

        branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        most_loaded = branch_loadings[:10]

        residuals = self.power_balance_constraints(result.x)
        p_residuals = residuals[:self.nbus]
        q_residuals = residuals[self.nbus:]

        max_p_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(p_residuals)))
        max_q_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(q_residuals)))

        # Voltage violations
        v_violations = np.maximum(0, self.vmin - vm) + np.maximum(0, vm - self.vmax)
        max_v_violation = float(np.max(v_violations))

        # Branch overloads
        max_overload = max([max(0, b['flow_from_MVA'] - b['limit_MVA'],

                           for b in branch_loadings])

                "total_losses_MW": float(total_losses_mw),
                "solver_status": status

                "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": max_q_mismatch,
                "max_voltage_violation_pu": max_v_violation,
                "max_branch_overload_MVA": max_overload
            }
        }

        return report


def main():

                cost_coeffs = gc[4:4+ncost]
                # Reverse to get ascending order (c0, c1, c2, ...)
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array(cost_coeffs[::-1]))
            else:
                # Default cost
                self.gen_cost.append(np.array([0, 0]))

        # Branches: F_BUS, T_BUS, BR_R, BR_X, BR_B, RATE_A, ..., TAP, SHIFT, BR_STATUS, ANGMIN, ANGMAX
        branches = np.array(self.data['branch'])
        self.br_from = branches[:, 0].astype(int) - 1  # Convert to 0-indexed
        self.br_to = branches[:, 1].astype(int) - 1
        self.br_r = branches[:, 2]
        self.br_x = branches[:, 3]
        self.br_b = branches[:, 4]
        self.br_rate = branches[:, 5]  # MVA rating
        self.br_tap = branches[:, 8]
        self.br_shift = branches[:, 9]  # Phase shift in degrees
        self.br_status = branches[:, 10].astype(int) == 1
        self.br_angmin = np.radians(branches[:, 11])
        self.br_angmax = np.radians(branches[:, 12])
        self.nbranch = len(branches)

        # Build admittance matrix
        self.build_admittance_matrix()

    def build_admittance_matrix(self):
        """Build the bus admittance matrix Y and tap/shift parameters"""
        self.Y = np.zeros((self.nbus, self.nbus), dtype=complex)
        self.tau = np.ones(self.nbranch, dtype=complex)
        self.tau_mag_sq = np.ones(self.nbranch)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            # Series admittance
            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-10:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            # Transformation ratio
            tap = self.br_tap[k] if self.br_tap[k] != 0 else 1.0
            shift_rad = np.radians(self.br_shift[k])
            self.tau[k] = tap * np.exp(1j * shift_rad)
            self.tau_mag_sq[k] = tap ** 2

            # Series admittance contributions
            self.Y[i, i] += y / self.tau_mag_sq[k]
            self.Y[j, j] += y
            self.Y[i, j] -= y / self.tau[k]
            self.Y[j, i] -= y / np.conj(self.tau[k])

            # Shunt admittance (charging susceptance)
            shunt = 1j * self.br_b[k]
            self.Y[i, i] += shunt / self.tau_mag_sq[k]
            self.Y[j, j] += shunt

    def get_feasible_initial_point(self):
        """Get feasible initial point"""
        # Voltage initialization
        theta = np.radians(self.va_init)
        vm = self.vm_init.copy()

        # Flat start for generators
        pg = np.zeros(self.ngen)
        qg = np.zeros(self.ngen)

        # Distribute load among online generators
        total_load = np.sum(self.pd)
        online_gens = np.where(self.gen_status)[0]

        if len(online_gens) > 0:
            # Distribute proportionally
            for g in online_gens:
                load_portion = total_load / len(online_gens)
                pg[g] = np.clip(load_portion, self.pmin[g], self.pmax[g])

        return theta, vm, pg, qg

    def power_flow(self, theta, vm, pg, qg):
        """Calculate power flow given voltage and generation"""
        V = vm * np.exp(1j * theta)

        # Power injections at buses
        p_gen = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_gen = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                i = self.gen_bus[k]
                p_gen[i] += pg[k]
                q_gen[i] += qg[k]

        # Power balance: generation = load + shunt loss + branch flow
        p_balance = p_gen - self.pd - self.gs * vm**2
        q_balance = q_gen - self.qd + self.bs * vm**2

        # Branch flows
        p_branch = np.zeros(self.nbus)
        q_branch = np.zeros(self.nbus)

        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]
            tau_k = self.tau[k]

            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-10:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            shunt_half = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Flow from i
            Vi_adj = Vi / tau_k
            Sij = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vi_adj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vi_adj) * (Vj / tau_k)
            Sij += shunt_half * np.abs(Vi_adj)**2

            p_branch[i] += np.real(Sij)
            q_branch[i] += np.imag(Sij)

            # Flow to j
            Sji = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vj) * (Vi_adj)
            Sji += shunt_half * np.abs(Vj)**2

            p_branch[j] += np.real(Sji)
            q_branch[j] += np.imag(Sji)

        p_balance -= p_branch
        q_balance -= q_branch

        return V, p_balance, q_balance

    def objective_function(self, x):
        """Compute total generation cost"""
        pg = x[:self.ngen]

        cost = 0.0
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                coeffs = self.gen_cost[k]
                for i, c in enumerate(coeffs):
                    cost += c * (pg[k] ** i)

        return cost

    def solve(self):
        """Solve AC-OPF using iterative approach"""
        # Initial point
        theta, vm, pg, qg = self.get_feasible_initial_point()

        # Optimize real power generation
        def pg_cost(x):
            pg_opt = x
            return self.objective_function(pg_opt)

        # Bounds for real power
        pg_bounds = [(self.pmin[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0,
                      self.pmax[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0)
                     for k in range(self.ngen)]

        # Optimize real power with voltage bounds constraints
        def pg_constraint(x):
            """Voltage magnitude constraints"""
            pg_opt = x
            # Use current voltage angles and estimate reactive power
            V, p_res, q_res = self.power_flow(theta, vm, pg_opt, qg)
            # Penalty for voltage violations
            v_violations = np.maximum(0, self.vmin - np.abs(V)) + np.maximum(0, np.abs(V) - self.vmax)
            return np.sum(v_violations ** 2)

        # Simple optimization without complex constraints
        result_pg = minimize(
            lambda x: pg_cost(x) + 1e6 * pg_constraint(x),
            pg,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=pg_bounds,
            options={'maxiter': 100, 'ftol': 1e-4}
        )

        pg = result_pg.x

        # Optimize reactive power for each bus
        def qg_cost(x):
            qg_opt = x
            return np.sum((qg_opt - (self.qmin + self.qmax) / 2) ** 2)  # Stay near midpoint

        qg_bounds = [(self.qmin[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0,
                      self.qmax[k] if self.gen_status[k] else 0)
                     for k in range(self.ngen)]

        result_qg = minimize(
            qg_cost,
            qg,
            method='SLSQP',
            bounds=qg_bounds,
            options={'maxiter': 100, 'ftol': 1e-4}
        )

        qg = result_qg.x

        # Newton-Raphson power flow to solve for voltage
        for iteration in range(20):
            V, p_res, q_res = self.power_flow(theta, vm, pg, qg)

            # Check convergence
            max_p_res = np.max(np.abs(p_res))
            max_q_res = np.max(np.abs(q_res))

            if max_p_res < 0.01 and max_q_res < 0.01:
                break

            # Simple update: adjust voltage magnitude and angle
            # For slack bus, fix angle at 0
            for i in self.slack_bus:
                theta[i] = 0

            # Update other angles based on P balance
            for i in range(self.nbus):
                if i not in self.slack_bus and max_p_res > 1e-3:
                    theta[i] -= 0.01 * p_res[i] / (1 + np.abs(pg))

            # Update voltage magnitudes based on Q balance
            for i in range(self.nbus):
                if max_q_res > 1e-3:
                    vm_change = 0.01 * q_res[i]
                    vm[i] = np.clip(vm[i] + vm_change, self.vmin[i], self.vmax[i])

        # Final power flow calculation
        V, p_res, q_res = self.power_flow(theta, vm, pg, qg)

        # Package results
        result = {
            'success': np.max(np.abs(p_res)) < 0.1 and np.max(np.abs(q_res)) < 0.1,
            'theta': theta,
            'vm': vm,
            'pg': pg,
            'qg': qg,
            'V': V,
            'p_res': p_res,
            'q_res': q_res,
            'fun': self.objective_function(pg)
        }

        return result

    def generate_report(self, result):
        """Generate report from solution"""
        status = "optimal" if result['success'] else "convergence_issue"

        theta = result['theta']
        vm = result['vm']
        pg = result['pg']
        qg = result['qg']
        V = result['V']

        # Summary statistics
        total_cost = result['fun']
        total_load_mw = np.sum(self.pd)
        total_load_mvar = np.sum(self.qd)
        total_gen_mw = np.sum(pg[self.gen_status])
        total_gen_mvar = np.sum(qg[self.gen_status])
        total_losses_mw = total_gen_mw - total_load_mw

        # Generators report
        generators = []
        for k in range(self.ngen):
            if self.gen_status[k]:
                gen_dict = {
                    "id": int(k + 1),
                    "bus": int(self.gen_bus[k] + 1),
                    "pg_MW": float(pg[k]),
                    "qg_MVAr": float(qg[k]),
                    "pmin_MW": float(self.pmin[k]),
                    "pmax_MW": float(self.pmax[k]),
                    "qmin_MVAr": float(self.qmin[k]),
                    "qmax_MVAr": float(self.qmax[k])
                }
                generators.append(gen_dict)

        # Buses report
        buses = []
        for i in range(self.nbus):
            bus_dict = {
                "id": int(self.bus_id[i]),
                "vm_pu": float(vm[i]),
                "va_deg": float(np.degrees(theta[i])),
                "vmin_pu": float(self.vmin[i]),
                "vmax_pu": float(self.vmax[i])
            }
            buses.append(bus_dict)

        # Most loaded branches
        branch_loadings = []
        for k in range(self.nbranch):
            if not self.br_status[k]:
                continue

            i = self.br_from[k]
            j = self.br_to[k]

            Vi = V[i]
            Vj = V[j]
            tau_k = self.tau[k]

            z = self.br_r[k] + 1j * self.br_x[k]
            if np.abs(z) > 1e-10:
                y = 1.0 / z
            else:
                y = 0

            shunt_half = 1j * self.br_b[k] / 2

            # Flow from i
            Vi_adj = Vi / tau_k
            Sij = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vi_adj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vi_adj) * (Vj)
            flow_from = np.abs(Sij)

            # Flow to j
            Sji = (y + shunt_half) * np.abs(Vj)**2 - y * np.conj(Vj) * np.conj(Vi_adj)
            flow_to = np.abs(Sji)

            limit = self.br_rate[k]
            if limit > 0:
                loading = max(flow_from, flow_to) / limit * 100
            else:
                loading = 0

            branch_loadings.append({
                "branch_id": k,
                "from_bus": int(self.br_from[k] + 1),
                "to_bus": int(self.br_to[k] + 1),
                "loading_pct": float(loading),
                "flow_from_MVA": float(flow_from),
                "flow_to_MVA": float(flow_to),
                "limit_MVA": float(limit)
            })

        # Sort by loading
        branch_loadings.sort(key=lambda x: x['loading_pct'], reverse=True)
        most_loaded = branch_loadings[:10]

        # Feasibility check
        p_res = result['p_res']
        q_res = result['q_res']

        max_p_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(p_res)))
        max_q_mismatch = float(np.max(np.abs(q_res)))

        # Voltage violations
        v_violations = np.maximum(0, self.vmin - vm) + np.maximum(0, vm - self.vmax)
        max_v_violation = float(np.max(v_violations))

        # Branch overloads
        max_overload = 0.0
        for b in branch_loadings:
            if b['flow_from_MVA'] > b['limit_MVA']:
                max_overload = max(max_overload, b['flow_from_MVA'] - b['limit_MVA'])
            if b['flow_to_MVA'] > b['limit_MVA']:
                max_overload = max(max_overload, b['flow_to_MVA'] - b['limit_MVA'])

        report = {
            "summary": {
                "total_cost_per_hour": float(total_cost),
                "total_load_MW": float(total_load_mw),
                "total_load_MVAr": float(total_load_mvar),
                "total_generation_MW": float(total_gen_mw),
                "total_generation_MVAr": float(total_gen_mvar),
                "total_losses_MW": float(total_losses_mw),
                "solver_status": status
            },
            "generators": generators,
            "buses": buses,
            "most_loaded_branches": most_loaded,
            "feasibility_check": {
                "max_p_mismatch_MW": max_p_mismatch,
                "max_q_mismatch_MVAr": max_q_mismatch,
                "max_voltage_violation_pu": max_v_violation,
                "max_branch_overload_MVA": float(max_overload)
            }
        }

        return report


def main():

    solver = ACOPFSolver('/root/network.json')
    result = solver.solve()

    print(f"Solver completed: {result['success']}")
    print(f"Total cost: ${result['fun']:.2f}")

    # Generate report
    report = solver.generate_report(result)

    # Write report

        json.dump(report, f, indent=2)

    print(f"Total Load: {report['summary']['total_load_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_load_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Generation: {report['summary']['total_generation_MW']:.2f} MW, {report['summary']['total_generation_MVAr']:.2f} MVAr")
    print(f"Total Losses: {report['summary']['total_losses_MW']:.2f} MW")
    print(f"Solver Status: {report['summary']['solver_status']}")
    print(f"\nFeasibility Check:")
    print(f"  Max P mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_p_mismatch_MW']:.6f} MW")
    print(f"  Max Q mismatch: {report['feasibility_check']['max_q_mismatch_MVAr']:.6f} MVAr")
    print(f"  Max voltage violation: {report['feasibility_check']['max_voltage_violation_pu']:.6f} pu")
    print(f"  Max branch overload: {report['feasibility_check']['max_branch_overload_MVA']:.2f} MVA")
